Pune, India (Hybrid)

3–6 Years

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Kafka, event-driven architectures, and asynchronous processing.

* Experience modernizing legacy Java applications.
* Knowledge of application monitoring, logging, tracing, and performance tuning.
* Experience working on high-volume transaction or workflow-processing systems.

* Hands-on engineer who takes ownership of features from development through production support.
* Strong collaborator who follows established architecture patterns and coding standards.

We're building intelligence that keeps customers connected effortlessly across calls, text, email, and beyond. title: Java Backend Engineer (Quant Analytics), Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
**About Quantitative Analytics Engineering**
BlackRock is one of the world’s preeminent asset management firms and an outstanding provider of global investment management, risk management, and advisory services to institutional, intermediary and individual investors around the world. Besides offering a range of investment solutions — from fundamental and quantitative active management approaches to highly efficient indexing strategies – BlackRock also provides direct access to its market leading analytic models by onboarding clients to its Aladdin Platform, an end-to-end portfolio management software solution.
  
  
The Investments and Trading Engineering (ITE) team builds and delivers Aladdin's industry-leading risk management, portfolio management, compliance and trading capabilities. Within ITE, Quantitative Analytics Engineering (QAE) is a global team of quantitative developers responsible for the implementation of security valuation, portfolio risk, liquidity and performance attribution models. BlackRock Portfolio managers and external Aladdin clients such as pension funds and insurance companies rely on models maintained by QAE to identify investment opportunities, build portfolios and manage risk.
  
  
**About The Role**
We invite experienced professionals to join QAE India as Senior Java Developers to contribute to the development of the next-generation portfolio risk analytics and modeling engine.
  
  
As part of a high-performing team, you will play a key role in transforming our portfolio risk analytics platform into a more scalable and modular architecture.
  
  
Your responsibilities will include designing new modules and APIs, as well as developing application servers that offer clients innovative methods for leveraging our analytics and models. You will provide technical leadership to junior team members and engage with users and stakeholders to gather and refine external client requirements. Additionally, you will collaborate closely with quantitative researchers and product managers at BlackRock to fully understand business use cases and identify opportunities to enhance operational efficiency on the newly developed platform.
  
  
We work in an integrated, agile team with a focus on quality of work validated through automated testing, and we value effective and clean code.
  
  
Our analytical models are the heart of BlackRock, having them delivered in a scalable and reliable way is a cross-team effort valued by all the parties involved.
  
  
**About Our Team**
Portfolio Risk Engineering is an established team of QAE with presence in Gurgaon, Mumbai, Budapest, New York and San Francisco.
  
  
We develop scalable, high throughput, analytical software for portfolio risk analytics.
  
  
Challenging the status quo is our norm, and we excel in building modern systems and onboarding innovative technology like microservice architecture. We are pioneers of the firm and early adopters of new tools and industry standards.
  
  
You’ll collaborate closely with quantitative researchers, product managers, and platform engineers to develop robust risk and optimization solutions.
  
  
Our dominant programming languages are Java and Python. We are passionate about what we do and hope you are, too!
  
  
**Requirements**
**You should be**

* B.E/ B.Tech/ Masters in Computer Science or related field.
* Experienced in enterprise software development: 6+ years of hands-on Core Java experience.
* In-depth understanding of Java internals, memory and performance optimization and tools.
* Quantitative developer with practical experience working with numerical computer methods
* Prior experience working in investment management industry
* Ready to lead. Work experience where you were responsible for or owner of an application, project or component. Willingness and ability to provide tutoring and mentorship to less experienced team members.

**You are familiar with**

* Java 17
* Basic knowledge of calculus and linear algebra
* Investment management business domain

**Nice to know**

* Java and Python math modelling libraries
* Messaging systems like MQ or Kafka
* Google Protocol Buffers
* Unix systems (Red Hat, Ubuntu)
* Profiling tools (VisualVM, JProfiler).

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

description:
**Description**
We’re building the identity and access layer that every service in our SaaS control plane depends on. You’ll own the common auth stack — making sure the right principals get the right access, consistently, across every tenant and product surface.
  
  
**Requirements**
You should have
  
  
– 5+ years building auth systems in production SaaS environments.
  
  
– Strong Go or Python (ideally both); comfortable writing performant, well-tested service code in either.
  
  
– Deep knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, and SAML — not just using libraries but understanding what’s happening underneath.
  
  
– Experience with authorization policy engines (OPA, Casbin, or equivalent) and modeling complex permission structures.
  
  
– Familiarity with multi-tenant isolation patterns and the security implications of getting them wrong.
  
  
– Comfort in an AWS/EKS environment with secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault).
  
  
Nice to have: SCIM provisioning, FIDO2/WebAuthn, zero-trust networking, SOC 2 audit experience, or prior work on a shared platform team serving internal consumers.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
– Design and operate the centralized authn/authz platform: token issuance and validation (OIDC/JWT), OAuth 2.0 flows, API key management, and service-to-service identity.
  
  
– Build and maintain the authorization model: RBAC and ABAC policies, tenant isolation enforcement, and fine-grained permission evaluation (Open Policy Agent or similar).
  
  
– Expose auth as a shared internal service consumed by the rest of the control plane — clean APIs, well-documented contracts, and minimal coupling.
  
  
– Partner with product and platform teams to implement SSO integrations (SAML, SCIM) and onboard enterprise identity providers.
  
  
– Harden the auth layer: token rotation, secret management, audit logging, and threat modeling against common identity attacks.
  
  
– Drive adoption of consistent auth patterns across services, replacing one-off implementations.

description:
About the role

We are hiring a Senior .NET Commerce Integration Engineer to build and run the APIs that connect our retail mobile app to SAP Commerce Cloud ( e-commerce platform) and to ERP, order management and warehouse systems. You will own the middleware layer: secure APIs, Azure API Management policies, real-time order and inventory sync, and the reliability patterns that keep a customer-facing app fast during peak trading.

* **Location:**
  Remote / hybrid (to be confirmed by client)
* **Type:**
  Full-time or contract
* **Experience:**
  6–10 years in backend development, at least 3 in integration-heavy roles
* **Reports to:**
  Integration / Solution Architect

Key responsibilities

1. **Build and maintain backend APIs**
   in .NET 8/9 (ASP.NET Core) that serve the POQ mobile app: product catalogue, pricing, basket, checkout, customer account, loyalty and order history, built on SAP Commerce OCC REST APIs.
2. **Design real-time commerce integrations**
   that sync orders, inventory and stock availability between SAP Commerce Cloud, ERP/OMS and the warehouse system (WMS), using event-driven patterns (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Functions, webhooks).
3. **Own Azure API Management (APIM)**
   : write and maintain policies for JWT validation, rate limiting and quotas, caching, request/response transformation, CORS, IP filtering, backend routing and retries.
4. **Secure the platform**
   : validate JWT/OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect tokens server-side (signature, issuer, audience, expiry, key rotation via JWKS), and keep all secrets in Azure Key Vault accessed through Managed Identity.
5. **Engineer for failure**
   : implement timeouts, retries with exponential backoff and jitter, circuit breakers, rate-limit handling (HTTP 429 / Retry-After) and dead-letter queues using Polly / Microsoft.Extensions.Resilience.
6. **Guarantee data integrity**
   : make sync processes idempotent (idempotency keys, upserts, de-duplication, outbox pattern) so duplicate or out-of-order messages never create double orders or wrong stock.
7. **Optimise performance**
   : call independent downstream APIs in parallel (async/await, Task.WhenAll), manage HttpClient correctly via IHttpClientFactory / typed clients, and keep mobile response times low.
8. **Accelerate delivery with code generation**
   : generate API clients and models from OpenAPI/Swagger specs (NSwag, Kiota, AutoRest, Refit) rather than hand-writing them.
9. **Modernise legacy code**
   : support existing .NET Framework 4.8 services and plan their migration to modern .NET.
10. **Operate what you build**
    : monitoring and alerting with Application Insights / Azure Monitor, CI/CD with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and production support during peak trading.

**What You’ll Do**
**Squad Technical Leadership**

* Own squad technical direction — run design sessions before implementation, challenge proposals, and ensure services are designed correctly before code is written.
* Primary technical interface between the Software Architect and the squad — translate architectural direction into squad-level implementation decisions across all services.
* Review and challenge low-level designs from squad engineers — identify design debt, scalability risks, and contract inconsistencies before they reach production.
* Own squad-level technical standards — API contract conventions, observability patterns, test architecture, and code quality bar across all squad services.
* Identify systemic quality issues across the squad — patterns of technical debt, repeated design mistakes, and coverage gaps that affect collective delivery quality.

**Hands-On Engineering Delivery**

* Own and deliver the most technically complex service implementations in the squad.
* Review critical PRs with depth and set the engineering standard through example.
* Own CI/CD pipeline integration, observability instrumentation, and production-readiness gates for squad services.

**System Design**

* Lead squad-level high-level design sessions — cross-service interaction patterns, failure modes, and data contracts across service boundaries.
* Make system design trade-off decisions independently — latency vs. consistency, synchronous vs. event-driven, shared vs. isolated data models.
* Proactively flag architectural risks — scalability bottlenecks, failure cascade risks, and integration complexity in squad designs before they affect delivery.

**Technical Mentorship**

* Mentor Principal and Senior Engineers — design reviews as learning sessions, actionable technical feedback, deliberate capability building across the squad.
* Make design reasoning visible and transferable — the squad’s technical level rises because the Tech Lead explains why, not just what.

**Who You Are**
**Python Backend Engineering — Primary Gate**

* 10+ years in software engineering with primary depth in Python backend systems — FastAPI, async patterns, service design, error handling, and observability at production scale.
* Low-level system design at lead depth — designs and reviews components, data structures, service internals, and API contracts from first principles. Applies the same rigour to others’ designs as to their own.

**System Design — Primary Gate**

* High-level system design at working depth — cross-service interaction patterns, failure modes, and data contracts. Leads squad design sessions and makes trade-off decisions independently.
* Distributed systems depth — failure modes, scalability trade-offs, consistency vs. availability, and graceful degradation for shared platform services.

**Technical Depth**

* Event-driven architecture — message ordering, delivery guarantees, idempotency, and failure handling. Designs and reviews event-driven services with equal depth.
* Multi-tenant data architecture — tenant isolation, data partitioning, row-level security, and cross-tenant boundary enforcement.
* Immutable data design and append-only event patterns — owns at design review level, not just implementation.
* API design and OpenAPI contracts — designs, versions, and governs platform APIs. Contract consistency across squad services is a Tech Lead ownership item.
* SQL and NoSQL at production scale — schema design, query optimisation, indexing, and data modelling trade-offs across service boundaries.
* Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm — production deployment, release engineering, and squad-level CI/CD pipeline ownership.

**Awareness**

* Security and IAM patterns — OAuth flows and token propagation at service level. Sufficient to identify security gaps in squad designs and escalate to the Platform Architect.
* API gateway and platform integration — how squad services are exposed through the platform layer. LLM and agent service patterns: sufficient to design service interfaces that agent consumers can build against.

* Workflow orchestration — Temporal or equivalent. AI-native SDLC: Human-led Agentic SDLC practices.
* Azure cloud experience. Experience building audit, compliance, or billing platform capabilities.

**What You’ll Learn & Gain**

* Squad-level technical ownership on a live enterprise AI platform — design decisions and technical standards that shape the quality of every service the squad ships.
* System design depth accelerated by owning cross-service decisions, running design reviews, and making trade-off calls that service-level IC roles rarely require.
* Technical leadership as a senior IC — growing Principal and Senior Engineers through design review and mentorship, with clear paths toward Staff Engineer, Architect, or Engineering Manager in the Bangalore market.
* Direct collaboration with the Software Architect and Engineering Manager in a fast-moving, squad-based delivery model where technical decisions have immediate, visible production consequences.

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Integrations and Internal Systems
description:
Grove Collaborative is a sustainability-focused consumer products company creating household and personal care essentials that are effective, beautifully designed, and healthier for people and the planet. We are a certified B Corp, plastic-neutral, and on a mission to transform the CPG industry for good.
  
  
Grove Collaborative is a sustainability-focused consumer products company creating household and personal care essentials that are effective, beautifully designed, and healthier for people and the planet. We are a certified B Corp, plastic-neutral, and on a mission to transform the CPG industry for good.
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
This isn't a role for someone waiting to be told what to build. We want a true self-starter: endlessly curious, genuinely ambitious, and humble enough to be trusted with real influence.
  
  
This person will own our internal systems integrations and the delivery of our MCP layer. You'll keep the lights on while identifying incremental improvements, and build the layer that enables the business to become builders and lets agents do real work safely. You'll spend time in both worlds, often in the same week, sometimes in the same day.
  
  
You're an enabler with a high level of ownership, ready to flex whatever muscle the day calls for. An integration breaks — you fix it. The business needs new functionality — you build it. Our MCP layer needs a new connection — you stand it up.
  
  
**You think beyond the fix.**
We don't just want someone who keeps integrations running — we want someone who's constantly looking for the opportunity to simplify and consolidate them. You know the difference between patching something and rebuilding it onto better infrastructure, and you have a bias toward leaving every system you touch better than you found it, not just functional.
  
  
**AI isn't an add-on here — it's how the work gets done.**
This is an AI-enabled role in an AI-enabled organization. You'll use AI tooling to write code, maintain the environment, and move faster across a wider surface area than one engineer could otherwise cover. It's not a tool you reach for occasionally; it's part of your everyday process.
  
  
We're just getting started building the infrastructure that lets everyone in the business become a builder. There's no finished playbook. Our MCP layer doesn't have an established pattern for security, access control, or agent tooling yet — you'll help write it, in partnership with the people who own the roadmap.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Back-office integrations — Maintain and enhance the integrations connecting NetSuite, HighJump, our data warehouse, and adjacent systems. Rebuild individual flows onto better infrastructure when it makes sense to, and know the difference between a fix and a rebuild. Go beyond maintenance to actively look for ways to simplify and consolidate our integration landscape — fewer moving parts, less duplicated logic, systems that are easier for the next person to reason about.
* Grove Brain / internal MCP layer — Build Grove Brain out from its current early stage into a durable platform other teams build on. Design and implement the connectors and tools that let agents act on real Grove systems.
* Security, access, and governance for agents — Help define and build how agents authenticate, what they're allowed to touch, and how that's audited, in partnership with the teams who own security and infrastructure rather than setting policy solo.
* Hands-on enablement — Be the person a team calls when they're stuck mid-build on an integration or an agent problem, whether that's a connector, a permissions question, or a "we don't know what's possible yet" question.
* Judgment calls — Decide when a systems problem is yours to solve and when it's actually a process problem that belongs to the business.
* AI-assisted development — Use AI tooling aggressively as a force multiplier, and hold the line on quality while you do it. You should be moving noticeably faster than an engineer working without these tools, without your standards slipping. More on this below.
* Craft, performance, and quality — Own performance, stability and maintainability in the code you ship, at the scale Grove actually runs at.

**About You**

* 5+ years building and operating building and maintaining production system integrations — the kind that move data between platforms like NetSuite, HighJump, or similar ERP/WMS systems.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: you can design a pipeline, debug it under pressure, and know the difference between a quick fix and a real one.
* Genuine hands-on experience with AI tools and, ideally, agent frameworks or MCP — not just familiarity, but a track record of building with them.
* Comfortable operating with a rough direction instead of a finished spec, and you make real progress anyway.
* A builder's mindset — you'd rather stand something up yourself than write a design doc for someone else to build.
* Enough security instinct to ask the right questions about what an agent should and shouldn't be able to touch, even when you're not the final decision-maker on policy.
* You're honest about what you don't know. You can say "I haven't worked with that" without flinching, and you don't paper over the gap with a confident guess.
* Background with Airflow, Airbyte, or similar data-pipeline infrastructure
* New technology doesn’t scare you. You’ve been dropped into an unfamiliar framework, language, or platform and gotten productive fast, and you can point to a time you did it. You evaluate new tools on the merits instead of defaulting to what you already know or chasing whatever is new.
* You’re honest about what you don’t know. You can say “I haven’t worked with that” without flinching, and you don’t paper over the gap with a confident guess.
* You’ve taken something vague, made it concrete, brought other people along, and shipped it.
* You work well with others. You give direct feedback kindly, you take it well, and people want you on their project.
* A real sense of ownership and pride in the experiences you ship and the code you leave behind.
* You write things down, and people understand them. You can a non-technical person through a technical tradeoff without hiding behind jargon.
* Genuine enthusiasm for Grove’s mission and sustainability values, not just the tech stack.

**How We Work Together**

* This is a high trust environment. You’ll get real scope and real decisions early, and nobody is going to look over your shoulder while you do the work. Trust runs both directions: we’ll be straight with you about the business, the tradeoffs, and the parts of the codebase we aren’t proud of, and we expect that same candor back.
* We value psychological safety first and foremost. It’s the precondition for everything else on this list. The teams that solve genuinely hard problems are the ones where people feel safe saying “I don’t understand this yet.”
* “I haven’t worked with that” is a complete answer here. We have deep respect for an engineer who names the edge of their own knowledge instead of bluffing past it. We don’t need you to know everything. We need you to be honest about where your expertise begins and ends — and that honesty is worth more to us than a confident guess, in an interview and on the job.

**How We Think About AI**
We’re serious about this, so we’d rather be direct than let you find out later.
  
  

* AI tooling is part of how this team works every day, not an experiment on the side. We want someone who genuinely enjoys these tools and keeps getting better with them.
* Nobody here has AI figured out, and we’re skeptical of anyone who says they do. The tooling changes month to month. We are all working it out together, in the open. We’d rather hire someone actively learning than someone with a methodology to evangelize.
* We’re looking for someone whose judgment stays their own. You should be able to read what a model produced, disagree with it, and explain why — about architecture, about correctness, about whether the thing should be built at all.
* The version of this we don’t want: code that ships because a model was confident. If you can’t explain why your code looks the way it does, “the model wrote it” isn’t an answer.
* The version we do want: someone who moves twice as fast with these tools and whose standards didn’t move at all.
* This is where honesty about the edges of your knowledge matters most. AI makes it effortless to produce work you don’t actually understand. Flagging that is a strength here, not an admission.

Our interview process includes a take-home project and a working review session that covers system design, coding, product thinking, and how you use AI. We’d rather see how you actually work than quiz you on algorithms — there’s no LeetCode round.
  
  
**Even Better if You Have**

* Experience building or contributing to an MCP server or similar agent-tooling layer.
* Background with Airflow, Airbyte, or similar data-pipeline infrastructure, especially rebuilding integrations off a legacy iPaaS.
* Experience with NetSuite and/or HighJump integrations specifically.
* Experience setting up auth, access control, or auditing for AI agents operating on production systems.
* Experience at a fast-growing ecommerce company.

**What's In It For You**

* This full-time, exempt position is remote for candidates based in the following states: California, Maine, Pennsylvania, Nevada, North Carolina, Texas, Colorado, Washington, Illinois, New York, Missouri, and Massachusetts.
* Competitive benefits - medical, vision, dental
* Equity - shared success is core to our mission
* Flexible Paid Time Off - we care most about results
* Free VIP membership and 50% employee discount
* Working for a company that believes that a small group of people can change the world for the better by creating products and funding initiatives that help the planet!

**Compensation**
The salary range for this role is
**$144,000-185,000.**
Our compensation bands are determined based on market-specific cost of living data, meaning that
**the top of our salary range is reserved for the most experienced candidates in the highest cost of living areas across the country.**
In addition to the base salary, this role is eligible for an annual incentive target and equity.
  
  
**More About Grove**
Grove Collaborative Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: GROV) is the one-stop online destination for everyday essentials that create a healthier home and planet. Explore thousands of thoughtfully vetted products for every room and everyone in your home, including household cleaning, personal care, health and wellness, laundry, clean beauty, kitchen, pantry, kids, baby, pet care, and beyond. Everything Grove sells meets a higher standard — from health to sustainability and performance — so you get a great value without compromising your values. As a B Corp and Public Benefit Corporation, Grove goes beyond selling products: every order is carbon neutral, supports plastic waste cleanup initiatives, and lets you see and track the positive impact of your choices. Shopping with purpose starts at Grove.com.

We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering
  
  
Principal responsibilities
  
  
The Performance Testing Engineer will be responsible for defining and executing performance testing for HSBC Open Banking Cloud solutions, ensuring services meet non-functional requirements for scalability, resilience and stability. The role will work closely with engineering, SRE/DevOps, and product teams to identify bottlenecks early, drive performance improvements, and embed performance testing into CI/CD pipelines.
  
  

* Define performance testing strategy, approach and success criteria aligned to Open Banking non-functional requirements (throughput, latency, error rates, capacity and scalability).
* Design, build and maintain automated performance test suites (load, stress, endurance/soak, spike), integrating execution into CI/CD pipelines.
* Create realistic workload models using production-like usage patterns, including API-level test scenarios and data design suitable for performance testing.
* Analyse results (response times, resource utilisation, thread/connection behaviour, queueing), identify bottlenecks and provide actionable recommendations to development and platform teams.
* Collaborate with SRE/DevOps to set up performance environments, monitoring, dashboards and alerts using tooling such as Splunk, AppDynamics and CloudWatch.
* Validate performance of cloud-native components (for example API Gateway, AWS Lambda, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), load balancers, databases) and support tuning activities.
* Produce clear performance reports and communicate risks, remediation plans and trends to stakeholders; promote performance engineering best practices across the team.
* Support releases by providing performance sign-off evidence and contribute to incident triage where performance degradation is suspected.

**Requirements**

* Minimum Bachelor Degree of Engineering with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong hands-on experience in performance testing and performance engineering for APIs and distributed systems.
* Proven experience with performance test tools such as JMeter and/or Gatling (or equivalent), including scripting, parameterisation, correlation and result analysis.

**Job Title**

**So, who are we?**
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. Platform Enablement helps engineering teams adopt cloud platform capabilities confidently and independently. Success is measured by what teams can do without us, not by how many tickets we close.

title: Principal Cloud Architect
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
  
  
Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
  
  
At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
  
  
When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
  
  
**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
**About Skylo**
Skylo is a global Non-Terrestrial Network service provider based in Mountain View, CA, offering a service that allows smartphone and IoT cellular devices to connect directly over existing satellites. Skylo’s direct-to-device service is now live on millions of activated devices across five continents, with more than 60 million square kilometers of coverage, in partnership with multiple satellite operators, mobile network operators (MNOs), Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs. Devices connected over satellite are managed and served by Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN, featuring a 3GPP standards-based cloud-native base station and core. Skylo provides an anywhere, anytime connectivity solution that seamlessly roams between terrestrial and satellite networks. Our focus is on enabling connected services for people outdoors and connected workflows across three main verticals: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT.
  
  
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*
**Summary Of How You Will Impact Skylo**
Skylo is hiring a
**Principal Cloud Architect**
to help fulfill Skylo’s mission of making satellite connectivity available to all. As a senior leader within the
**Enterprise Systems & Security**
team, you will be the technical authority responsible for the robust cloud, data, and AI infrastructure that powers our global operations. You will design and implement the scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud foundations that enable our hybrid network connectivity to roam seamlessly between terrestrial and satellite networks.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Cloud Architecture & Strategy: Design and implement robust, scalable, and reliable cloud-based solutions while developing long-term strategies that align with Skylo’s global business goals.
* Infrastructure Optimization: Oversee cloud infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and availability, identifying continuous opportunities to enhance resource utilization.
* Cloud Security & Compliance: Establish and maintain rigorous security protocols for cloud resources (GCP/AWS), ensuring compliance with industry standards and safeguarding our digital assets.
* Cost Management: Lead cost optimization initiatives, including monitoring, rightsizing, and identifying underutilized resources to reduce infrastructure overhead.
* IAM & API Management: Streamline Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies and optimize API management workflows and costs using Apigee or alternative platforms.
* Disaster Recovery: Design and implement high-availability disaster recovery and backup strategies to minimize downtime and ensure service continuity.
* Technology Leadership: Serve as a subject matter expert, staying ahead of cloud technology advancements to provide recommendations that enhance Skylo's internal platform services.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with development, operations, and business teams to ensure the seamless delivery of cloud services across our 24x7 commercial network.

**What We Look For**

* Experience: 15+ years of experience in cloud architecture and infrastructure management.
* Technical Expertise: Deep proficiency in designing and maintaining complex cloud environments, specifically within AWS or GCP ecosystems.
* Certifications: Advanced professional certifications in AWS or GCP cloud architecture.
* Specialized Skills: Hands-on experience with IAM, API management (Apigee), and infrastructure automation tools.
* Leadership: Proven ability to lead complex technology initiatives and provide technical mentorship to engineering teams.
* Industry Context: Experience in telecommunications, satellite networks, or high-scale IoT environments is a significant plus.
* Every role at Skylo uses AI tools daily to amplify output. We expect active habits using AI tools and a track record of folding new ones into your workflow quickly

**What We Offer**
With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:
  
  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive benefits plans
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
* Access to world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends the Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics

description:
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates.
  
  
Requisition ID: 77773
  
  
**About Skyworks**
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out of the box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates.
  
  
Skyworks offers the industry’s broadest Timing product portfolio of crystal oscillator, clock generator, clock buffer, jitter attenuator and network synchronizer products. Our patented technology combines best-in-class frequency flexibility with the lowest jitter in the industry, delivering quick-turn, customized solutions that simplify board design, eliminate discrete components, and maximize system performance.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The IC Validation team leads all post-silicon activities, including chip bring-up, validation, and characterization of new timing devices. You will play a key role in our New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle, as our products cross from pre-silicon design to post-silicon validation to ensure exceptional product quality and performance. In this role, the ability to quickly debug and resolve performance issues will be critical to delivering world-class products to our customers.
  
  
We seek candidates who demonstrate a passion for learning, initiative, curiosity, and engineering ingenuity. A positive attitude and a strong disposition for teamwork are essential.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**

* Support our Timing Design team based out of the Skyworks Bangaluru office with new IC bring-up, validation, and characterization.
* Test and debug system and block functionality of new timing ICs.
* Perform silicon characterization through the development of robust and reusable tests to determine device datasheet specifications
* Lead the design and development of high-speed PCBs (EEVBs), including discrete analog circuits, used for validation and characterization.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Who we are**
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
  
  
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
  
  
**About the role**
As an Engineering Manager, you will drive the successful delivery and execution of projects within your teams. You will manage end-to-end technical planning, ensuring that product requirements are translated into actionable tasks, while orchestrating collaboration between various stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, QA, and UX. This role requires a deep understanding of software design and development and the ability to plan, execute, and deliver product features in a timely and predictable manner. You will also be responsible for maintaining high technical standards, managing team bandwidth, and ensuring project milestones are met with efficiency and accuracy.
  
  
**What you’ll get to do**

* Own end-to-end delivery and execution across cross-functional teams within your product area, ensuring predictable and high-quality outcomes.
* Evaluate business and product requirements for technical feasibility and architectural alignment, translating them into well-defined EPICs and technical user stories.
* Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Engineers to continuously refine, groom, and prioritize the backlog.
* Plan and drive sprint execution with clearly defined goals, using project planning tools to establish timelines, delivery milestones, and surface dependencies early.
* Champion engineering processes and rituals that enable strong collaboration, accountability, and team efficiency.
* Monitor team velocity and capacity to optimize resource allocation, proactively balancing bandwidth against delivery commitments.
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies and stakeholder alignment to remove bottlenecks and maintain smooth execution.
* Stay hands-on in critical initiatives by guiding design decisions, enforcing sound design patterns, and participating in code reviews to maintain high engineering quality.
* Ensure robust monitoring, alerting, and observability for all owned services, consistently meeting defined SLIs and SLOs.
* Partner with Product Managers to define, track, and publish post-release product metrics, driving transparency and continuous improvement.

**To succeed in this role, you should have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8-10 years of experience as a Software Developer, Software Engineer, or in a similar hands-on technical role.
* 5+ years of strong experience building production systems using Java and Spring Boot.
* Minimum 3 years of proven engineering leadership experience managing high-performing teams.
* Solid grasp of Agile methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and iterative delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex product requirements into well-structured EPICs, user stories, and tasks.
* Strong backend engineering expertise; exposure to frontend technologies is a plus.
* Experience with project planning and tracking tools to visualize and manage delivery timelines.
* Familiarity with engineering, product health metrics, and monitoring tools to drive data-informed decisions.
* Hands-on capability to debug complex production issues, lead incident response, and conduct blameless RCA.
* Good understanding of modern deployment practices, including CI/CD pipelines, release management, and associated metrics.
* Ability to drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.
* Excellent risk management, dependency tracking, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Proven track record of improving team velocity, delivery predictability, and engineering excellence.

**Generic Skills**

* Problem-solving: Ability to assess complex problems, find solutions, and make sound decisions.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation and stakeholder reporting.
* Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment, adjusting strategies as needed.
* Attention to Detail: Meticulous in documenting technical requirements and ensuring all aspects of a project are accounted for.

**Supervisory skills**

* Team Management: Experience in managing and mentoring engineers, ensuring team growth and performance.
* Resource Allocation: Ability to assess bandwidth and manage resource distribution to optimize team performance.
* Feedback: Conduct regular performance reviews, providing constructive feedback and fostering a growth-oriented environment.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead project status reviews, manage expectations, and ensure smooth communication between teams and leadership.

**What we can offer you**

* Culture - We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.

* Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, paid leave, plus other benefits.

* A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.
* A live coding and code review session.
* A system design and technical discussion round.
* A project planning, execution, and product thinking round.
* A behavioral and technical interview with the hiring manager.

description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
  
  
**Team Overview**
What: we drive credit risk solution delivery as technical product managers
  
  
How: we deliver new products to market, enhance existing products, modernize our platforms and products, and innovate new technical solutions for customers
  
  
Who: Technical product mangement leader will be Carla Leatherman This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
**Overview**
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
We are seeking a Technical Product Manager, Advisor to own technical delivery and application outcomes for a major product area or program workstream. You will translate strategy into a feasible 2–3 PI roadmap and lead multiple teams through design, build, testing, release, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This role may support real-time products and partners with Solutions, Data Science, Analytics, Compliance, Engineering, and Operations to deliver scalable credit risk solutions.
  
  
Success requires technical fluency, concise communication, independent judgment, and influence across a complex matrix. The TPM Advisor aligns partners, manages dependencies, and escalates issues with clear options and trade-offs.
  
  
**Why the role exists:**
Turn product strategy into coordinated technical delivery for complex, multi-team initiatives, specifically for our online credit risk products.
  
  
**Outcomes it drives:**
Predictable delivery, scalable and compliant solutions, stronger adoption, reliability, customer value, and growth.
  
  
**What the person owns:**
The roadmap, priorities, dependencies, risks, cross-functional decisions, release readiness, launch, and continuous improvement for online credit risk products.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
**Required Knowledge And Experiences**
**Workstream Strategy & Delivery Leadership**

* Translate strategy into a feasible, KPI-aligned roadmap for a major workstream across multiple teams and 2–3 PIs.
* Own priorities, sequencing, capacity assumptions, delivery waterlines, dependencies, and readiness criteria.
* Lead strategic Alternative Credit initiatives, including Alternative Data, Blended Scores, integrations, compliance, modernization, and customer onboarding.
* Resolve competing priorities using customer value, impact, risk, feasibility, urgency, and opportunity cost.
* Maintain predictable delivery by surfacing trade-offs and driving timely corrective action.

**Cross Functional Program Leadership**

* Lead complex delivery across Solutions, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Compliance, Operations, Architecture, Customer Success, and support teams.
* Turn roadmap commitments into outcome-based plans with clear milestones, owners, forecasts, dependencies, and success measures.
* Manage cross-team risks, impediments, and decisions; escalate with clear options, impacts, and recommendations.
* Establish planning, forecasting, risk-review, and KPI cadences that improve transparency and accountability.
* Provide stakeholders clear visibility into delivery health, changes, and corrective actions.

**Product Development Lifecycle Ownership**

* Own delivery from discovery and commitment through launch, adoption, and iteration.
* Maintain traceability across outcomes, roadmap commitments, requirements, delivery plans, releases, and results.
* Re-plan using customer feedback, KPIs, regulatory changes, risk, capacity, and readiness.
* Lead discovery, requirements, and solution trade-offs for complex, high-visibility initiatives.
* Ensure regulatory, model-governance, audit, data-quality, operational, and customer requirements are met.

**Quality, Risk & Operational Readiness**

* Lead workstream-level delivery, technical, operational, security, compliance, regulatory, and customer risk management.
* Maintain mitigation plans, escalation paths, release gates, readiness reviews, and clear accountability across teams.
* Balance timeline, scope, quality, technical debt, and operational risk in delivery recommendations.
* Partner with engineering to monitor reliability, defects, stability, and post-launch outcomes.
* Use root-cause analysis and lessons learned to reduce recurring issues and rework.

**Technical Expectations**
The Technical Product Manager understands application architecture, data flows, integration patterns, cloud constraints, and operational considerations well enough to guide delivery decisions with engineering.
  
  

* Partner with engineering and architecture on application design, implementation, testing, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Guide data-processing and integration decisions involving data movement, performance, resilience, debugging, and environment readiness.
* Partner with Data Science and Analytics to productionize models, features, score workflows, monitoring, and performance measures.
* Balance customer value, compliance, reliability, scalability, time to value, and technical debt.
* Communicate requirements, decisions, risks, trade-offs, and status clearly to technical teams and leaders.

**Leadership Expectations**
Lead through influence and ambiguity, align teams on priorities and trade-offs, and operate independently while strengthening delivery practices and outcomes.
  
  

* Set clear workstream priorities and delivery guardrails while empowering teams to execute.
* Build commitment through evidence, transparency, and clear trade-offs.
* Influence stakeholders without direct authority and maintain alignment through change.
* Coach junior TPMs and partner teams on planning, execution, risk, and accountability.

**Qualifications**

* Typically 8+ years in technical product management, application development, engineering, systems analysis, or data-processing delivery, including ownership of a major workstream across multiple teams.
* Bachelor’s degree required; financial services, insurance, or banking experience preferred.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum or SAFe delivery from requirements through post-launch adoption.
* Proven ability to translate strategy into a KPI-aligned 2–3 PI roadmap with priorities, capacity, waterlines, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Demonstrated ownership of multi-team execution, credible forecasts, cross-functional decisions, and corrective action.
* Experience leading risk, quality, release, and operational readiness, including evidence-based escalation and post-launch improvement.
* Strong technical partnership skills across application design, data processing, integrations, cloud platforms, performance, resiliency, and operational readiness.
* Clear written and verbal communication for business, technical, and senior leadership audiences.
* Ability to influence without authority and strengthen the practices of junior TPMs and partner teams.
* Preferred: Experience with credit risk, consumer reporting, FCRA, model governance, alternative data, scores or predictive models, cloud modernization, and GCP or AWS in an online environment; SAFe PO/PM or related certification.

**Expectations in the First 90 Days**

* Learn the product strategy, application ecosystem, delivery model, FactorTrust platform, Alternative Data products, Blended Scores, customer use cases, and regulatory context.
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Compliance, Operations, Legal, Marketing, and Customer Success.
* Assess the roadmap, delivery health, dependencies, quality controls, and operational risks; recommend an initial 2–3 PI plan.
* Establish a multi-team cadence for planning, forecasting, risk review, decisions, KPI reporting, ownership, and escalation.

**What You’ll Accomplish Beyond 90 Days**

* Independently lead discovery, solution design, delivery, testing, release, and adoption for complex initiatives.
* Own a feasible, KPI-aligned roadmap and delivery waterline across multiple teams and 2–3 PIs.
* Drive Alternative Credit and FactorTrust initiatives from concept through production, including compliance and modernization work.
* Lead quality, risk, release, and operational readiness; identify exposure early and drive mitigation.
* Deliver measurable improvements in customer value, adoption, reliability, compliance, efficiency, and growth.
* Introduce reusable planning, forecasting, governance, and readiness practices

, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.
  
  
Be a part of our
**Workforce for Good**
– you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.
